source_claim: AlphaEvolve-style long-running experiments require reproducible code and dependency environments; local editable package metadata does not by itself prove a verified release distribution
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve has pyproject metadata, a console-script declaration, and runtime environment/package provenance for editable or locally installed use, including bounded wheel metadata snapshots, direct_url/INSTALLER/RECORD evidence, and pip freeze/config hashes. CI also builds one wheel and one sdist, installs the wheel into an isolated virtual environment, smokes the console script, and checks every file under the libreevolve package tree inside the wheel and sdist. CI also writes release_artifact_provenance.json with wheel/sdist hashes and selected source-file hashes, then uploads the release smoke artifacts as GitHub Actions artifacts. It does not claim signed release provenance, published-index verification, or release-checklist readiness.
